context.transcript:
Thanks for coming out to look at my roof.
I got a little salary increase at my job recently, and I figured it was time to finally get this work done.
Yes, it's best to replace roofing before you start to have big problems like leaks.
So, when would your crew be able to begin?
Around the end of the month, but you'll need to select a material.
Here's a brochure that shows the materials we work with.
You have asphalt now, but you could consider other options.
I'm up for a change.
I like the look of this one.
I like that it doesn't require much maintenance and comes in a lot of colors.
context.transcript_translation:
谢谢您能过来看看我的屋顶。
我最近工作上加薪了一点，我想是时候把这个工程彻底完成了。
是的，在出现像漏水这样的大问题之前更换屋顶最好。
那么，您的团队什么时候可以开始？
大概月底，但您需要选择一种材料。
这里有一本手册，展示了我们合作的材料。
您现在用的是沥青，但您可以考虑其他选项。
我愿意改变一下。
我很喜欢这个外观。
我喜欢它不需要太多维护，而且有很多颜色可供选择。
